name: ENGINEAI SE01
summary:
SE01 is EngineAI's full-size humanoid platform focused on humanlike proportions and walking. Its body combines an aluminum-alloy structure with in-house joint mechanisms, while a perception system brings together lidar, depth and infrared cameras.

The robot includes five-finger hands for developing manipulation tasks. EngineAI uses learned motion control to produce its walking behavior and positions the platform for general humanoid application development. description.en:
SE01 is EngineAI's full-size humanoid platform focused on humanlike proportions and walking. Its body combines an aluminum-alloy structure with in-house joint mechanisms, while a perception system brings together lidar, depth and infrared cameras.

The robot includes five-finger hands for developing manipulation tasks. EngineAI uses learned motion control to produce its walking behavior and positions the platform for general humanoid application development. The combination of body-scale motion, perception and hand mechanisms supports experiments that require a robot to move and interact with objects, with the actual task capability determined by the software and hardware configuration.
description.zh: 采用真人比例与拟人结构的全尺寸通用人形机器人，通过端到端神经网络训练优化自然步态。
